description: Dewan Cement Limited is the cement arm of Yousuf Dewan Companies, which entered the sector by acquiring Pakland Cement Limited and Saadi Cement Limited in 2004 and merged them in September 2007. The company gives its combined installed capacity as 2.9 million tons a year across two plants: one in southern Pakistan at Deh Dhando, Dhabeji in Sindh near Karachi, and one in the north at Kamilpur, Hattar Industrial Estate in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa — positioning it for both local sales and export.
headOffice: Finance & Trade Center, 2nd Floor, Block-A, Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi-75350, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: https://yousufdewan.com/Sectors.html (acquisition of Pakland and Saadi Cement, 2007 merger, 2.9 million ton capacity, both plant locations and their markets), the Yousuf Dewan Companies site, and https://dewancement.com/Contact%20us.html (corporate and registered office addresses, telephones) (accessed 2026-10-17).
